name: @cpangular/simple-theming-demo
description: Static HTML demonstration of @cpangular/ng-material-theme with light-dark() support

scripts.build: sass --pkg-importer=node --load-path=node_modules src/styles.scss dist/styles.css && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp node_modules/@cpangular/ng-material-theme/css/dist/core.css node_modules/@cpangular/ng-material-theme/css/dist/theme-switcher.js dist/
